about: The size of a body of claims is how many questions it asks: distinct coordinates, never lines. Many lines at one
coordinate are one question, and read at a coarser resolution questions merge.

cases.name: ten lines over three coordinates are three questions
read at one step, they are two
one coordinate repeated is one question

coverage.criterion: lines over three coordinates, the same lines one step coarser, and one coordinate repeated
coverage.why: one body of lines; the count is of distinct coordinates only
